listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
A SIMPLE MACHINE makes work easier.
It can reduce the force needed or change the direction of force.
THE 6 SIMPLE MACHINES:
1. LEVER
- A bar that pivots on a fixed point
- Examples: seesaw, scissors, bottle opener
- Makes lifting heavy things easier
2. WHEEL AND AXLE
- A wheel attached to a rod
- Examples: car wheels, doorknobs
- Makes moving things easier
3. PULLEY
- A wheel with a rope
- Examples: flagpole, crane
- Changes direction of force or makes lifting easier
4. INCLINED PLANE
- A flat surface at an angle (ramp)
- Examples: slide, wheelchair ramp
- Easier to push up than lift straight up
5. WEDGE
- Two inclined planes put together
- Examples: knife, axe, nail
- Used to split things apart
6. SCREW
- An inclined plane wrapped around a cylinder
- Examples: screws, jar lids
- Holds things together
dictation: A SIMPLE MACHINE makes work easier.
It can reduce the force needed or change the direction of force.
